comment: Session-title generation asks for a 64-token completion with thinking off. Rules are first-match-wins, so the narrow match comes first.

The first real agent turn calls the plugin's model-facing tool. The harness executes it and sends the tool result back as the next request — that round trip is how the model-facing `task_run_config` loop is exercised without a real model. (`index` is the 1-based request ordinal.)
The request that carries the tool result settles the turn with a short text block.
